title: Largest City with Astra
author: Valentinevandal1986
selftext: I might have gone overboard. I was trying to make a city, 12x9 kilometers or 108km sq. Ended up being 22k enterable buildings. Probably going much smaller with the next one.  What’s the biggest city you’ve seen?

comments.author: Intelligent-Cap-8886
comments.body: Cool. Did you see the build someone came up with for converting city maps into 3d? Could be cool to combine them.

replies.author: Valentinevandal1986
replies.body: Yeah I’ve seen that. I’m trying to build like a 3d version of bitlife. Full freedom to do whatever you want but I’ve noticed AI has zero skills with freeways. I’ve been trying to figure out the right balance of density vs scale. This has way too much scale but not enough density, feels incredibly boring to drive grids so I’m trying to figure out the best approach. I’m looking at going for 6x4km in the next iteration but greater overall density.

replies.author: egonosz
replies.body: You could use real map as reference from open map, because all generated worlds run in to this problem they become homogeneous. If you have reference that maybe would help you. Do Astra places the buildings too? If it is I would swap it to procedural generation or something, because it is waste of tokens.

replies.author: Valentinevandal1986
replies.body: Yeah for the main buildings I had it essentially just build a modular toolkit, then I asked for some more unique architecture. The v1 map was much more spread out but I was running into the same issues with on/off ramps intersecting roadways in the ground with no traffic control, weird circular intersections. I am trying an entirely different method this next time where I’m building a reasoning chain of road network guidance so it will build the freeways with no issues prior to even making the buildings. I’m struggling with how to approach it to get the cohesive layered design I’m looking for. I’m trying to avoid the grid pattern style and have a more organically generated city, à la Liberty City or Night City, not perfect boxes, stuff with more personality. I’ve noticed Astra plays it pretty safe though and the results kind of look samey. I saw a couple people like 1 shot a “gta” clone but they all end up basically just looking like square boxes, no real personality.

comments.author: egonosz
comments.body: Are you sure they are enterable, the window on the building you stand are just flat textures?

replies.author: Valentinevandal1986
replies.body: Yeah, they are, ridiculous. They were only stairs, which some are like 40 floors, so I asked for elevators and Astra reasoned that they should go on the outside. None of the windows are transparent though so you can only see the scale from the rooftops

replies.author: egonosz
replies.body: Then they are basically boxes you can just render million of them.

replies.author: Valentinevandal1986
replies.body: Yeah it’s just not very compelling gameplay lol. It’s big but boring. There’s actually 5 islands, a suspension bridge and airport, thousands of residential homes. I made like 60% closed off on the main land and 90% closed off in the burbs, so there’s still thousands of locations you can enter at this point but the question is why? Is it compelling gameplay to drive 25 minutes across a city?

replies.author: Valentinevandal1986
replies.body: I generated maps using nano banana, then used sol to build the prompt, meshy for the character model and godot and blender locally on my machine. Astra did the city and this is actually my 4th iteration but this one took most of a weeks worth of usage , like 19 hours lol
